closing.summary: Big strengths are protein, omega 3, and magnesium, but the biggest weaknesses are low vitamin E, low calcium, and sugar. It is good for heart health, bone health, and digestion because fibre supports the heart-health side, calcium and magnesium gives the bone-health case something to work with, and fibre supports digestion and steadier meals.
